_: AURORA KART / U-Speak Racers, vendored whole and unedited. It is a SEPARATE GAME: its own three.js (r170 — the world outside runs r160, which is why the two cannot share a page), its own CSS, its own save keys (aurora-*). It runs in an iframe and nothing in it is imported by the game around it. To upgrade, replace this folder with a new build and re-run `node client/tests/racers-manifest.mjs --write`; the regression suite compares these hashes so a half-applied upgrade cannot pass unnoticed.
